scope: Full production application VM; controlled IndexedDB/localStorage adapters and completion ordering verify app lifecycle guards, blank startup, recovery and save ownership. Browser IndexedDB scheduling/durability, layout and native Save As remain outside this suite.

results.name: Cold startup is a blank viewer workspace with one effective autosave schedule and no recovery writes
IndexedDB-only recovery is gated from startup through discovery, including unload autosave
Legacy local recovery stays available even when IndexedDB is unavailable
Corrupt local recovery is retained and blocks autosave when IndexedDB cannot be read
Explicit restore loads recovery once, clears its record, and marks restored edits unsaved
Recovery deletion failure retains the recovery copy and leaves restored content unsaved
Legacy local recovery restores and clears both storage locations after success
Unsupported recovery rejects atomically and keeps the original bytes offered for recovery
Malformed recovery stays intact and can be explicitly dismissed without replacing the workspace
Dismiss invalidates a pending recovery read and gates autosave through deletion
Recovery storage denial leaves a usable blank editor with an accurate unavailable message
Late restore cannot overwrite author edits made while its storage read was pending
Late restore cannot overwrite a New Project replacement
Autosave queued before a project replacement cannot write the old snapshot afterward
An old browser save persists its original identity but cannot rebind a new project
Browser save completion cannot mark later edits clean even within the same lifecycle epoch
Unchanged browser save binds one saved identity and marks only the saved snapshot clean
A failed browser save does not change project identity, content or dirty status
Saved project opening uses one authoritative commit and restores its browser identity
A delayed saved-project read cannot replace a newer project
Project file opening uses one authoritative commit and preserves authored data
Delayed project-file reads cannot overwrite subsequent edits or project replacement
Portable JSON and ZIP completion cannot clear edits or update save status made after export began
Portable JSON and ZIP completion cannot rebind or mark a newer project saved
Unchanged JSON and ZIP portable saves complete only after close and update save status exactly once
Legacy lifecycle globals call the authoritative service once for each requested operation
